# BlendAudioScene <img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Audio](BlitzBasic-Audio)

</div>


```blitzbasic
BlendAudioScene:Void scene_a:Int32, scene_b:Int32, weight:Float32, fade_ms:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `scene_a` | In | Int32 | required | The scene at weight 0. |
| `scene_b` | In | Int32 | required | The scene at weight 1. |
| `weight` | In | Float32 | required | `0` is all of `scene_a`, `1` all of `scene_b`. Values outside are limited to that range. |
| `fade_ms` | In | Int32 | `0` | How many milliseconds it takes to get to the mix, `0` (the default) at once. About a frame keeps a crossfade smooth. |

## Description

<img class="product" src="media/bl-20x14.png" alt="BlitzLLVM" title="BlitzLLVM" width="20" height="14"> This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

Sets a mix of two scenes: every value that either holds, between the one of the first scene and the one of the second. Called every frame with a weight that follows the player, it crossfades from one place into another. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

## Differences

* A value that only one scene holds is mixed with its default: `1` for a bus volume, what [CreateListener](CreateListener) was given for rolloff, doppler and distance (1 without a listener), 340 for the speed of sound and 0 for the radius.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
; Walking into the cave: all outside at 20 units from the mouth, all cave at the mouth.
weight# = 1 - EntityDistance(camera, cave_mouth) / 20
BlendAudioScene outside, inside, weight, 20
```
